name: CADELL, Ross Philip

headline.note: Career evidence identifies events, motorsport, professional sport, party and port roles, but substantive full-time status and complete calendar boundaries are not established for the potentially countable roles. Port of Newcastle had mixed ownership, including a 50% China Merchants Port interest, so it is not silently classified as wholly private. Party work and elected office are excluded; missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.employer: Newcastle National Maritime Festival (legal employing entity unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: Contemporaneous Newcastle Herald reports, summarized in the secondary career source, identify Cadell as festival event manager in 2002–2004. The legal employer, exact dates, pay, hours and organisational control are unresolved. Senate speech7December2023 independently recalls work on the Newcastle maritime festival; corroborates activity, not original year endpoints or legal employer.
career_spells.counting_note: Neither employer sector nor substantive full-time status is sufficiently supported.

career_spells.employer: Alex Yoong / motorsport sponsorship arrangement (legal entity unresolved)
career_spells.evidence_note: A May 2004 motorsport release names Cadell as Alex Yoong's Australian manager, and his official personal biography confirms Formula 1/V8 Supercars experience. The contracting entity, end date, remuneration, weekly hours and overlap with other roles are unresolved. Corrected linked motorsport release also describes his financial contribution to the2004 racing arrangement; investment does not prove remuneration or employment hours.
career_spells.counting_note: Private commercial activity is supported, but no countable full-time interval is established.

career_spells.evidence_note: A contemporaneous Newcastle Herald report, summarized by the secondary career source, places his commencement in June 2005. His current official biography confirms work at the Knights. End date, employing legal entity, ownership form, hours and leave are unresolved. Club2010 statement identifies a member community club considering acquisition. This supports member-governance context but is later than known2005 employment start, and no constitution/payroll link or personal cessation found; category remains unresolved. Do not apply later Tinkler/NRL ownership retrospectively.
career_spells.counting_note: The club role is preserved, but employer classification and full-time duration are not sufficiently supported.

career_spells.evidence_note: A February 2007 Newcastle Herald report, summarized in the secondary career source, identifies Cadell as commercial director of the Newcastle motorsport team. The exact start/end dates, legal entity, hours, remuneration and overlap with other motorsport work are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: A private-enterprise role is identified, but no substantive full-time interval is proven.

career_spells.evidence_note: His current official biography says he dedicated nearly ten years to the NSW Nationals before the Senate. Reliable reporting places organiser/campaign-manager work from 2010 and records his promotion to state director in 2018. Individual campaign assignments, exact dates, hours and leave are incomplete.
career_spells.counting_note: Party-organisation employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The Land reported his appointment in January 2018; January 2020 reporting describes him as the outgoing state director on appointment to the port. Exact employment dates, hours and leave are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party-organisation employment is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Port of Newcastle Operations Pty Ltd
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen biography supplies 2020–2022 and January 2020 reporting establishes appointment timing. His official biography describes oversight of the proposed multipurpose deepwater terminal and alternative-energy precincts. Port of Newcastle states that The Infrastructure Fund and China Merchants Port Holdings each own 50%; the latter belongs to a state-controlled Chinese group. Exact cessation date, hours, leave and the 2021–2022 Senate campaign overlap are unresolved. Historical2020 report confirms equal shareholder interests during his tenure; contemporaneous23November2020 minutes name him in role. Report workforce table includes part-time male managers and supplies no individual match, so neither director title nor workforce totals establish his full-time status.
career_spells.counting_note: The employer was not wholly government-controlled or wholly private-controlled on the evidence used. Mixed control and unproven full-time status prevent assignment to either headline sector.

career_spells.evidence_note: June 2021 reporting establishes preselection as the Nationals' lead Senate candidate. Pay, hours, formal employment status, campaign leave and overlap with Port of Newcastle are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party/campaign activity is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen roster and current official biographies establish Senate service from 1 July 2022. Parliamentary and shadow roles are nested within elected service.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded under the codebook.

open_questions: What paid employment preceded the 2002 maritime-festival role, and what were the dates of any University of Newcastle study?
Which legal entity employed Cadell for the maritime festival, Newcastle Knights and each motorsport role, and what were the exact dates, hours and overlaps?
What work filled the gaps after Prodigy Motorsport and before NSW Nationals employment in 2010?
What were the exact dates, hours and leave for the NSW Nationals organiser, campaign-manager and state-director roles?
How should Port of Newcastle's 50/50 fund and foreign state-controlled ownership be treated under a future aggregate mixed-control rule, and was Cadell's role substantively full-time?
What were the Port cessation date and campaign leave arrangements between June 2021 preselection and Senate commencement?
research_notes: Systematic follow-up2026-10-01; repaired missing research_notes. Added omitted bank work, employment by Greg Hansen, gaming, university/cadet/party history and declared company directorship. Added primary historical employer evidence and repaired incorrect motorsport URL. Full-time totals remain null.

Bank could have been government-controlled depending on institution and date; both unknown. Hansen’s party position is not a substitute for identifying payroll employer or actual duties. Youth cadets and pilot training do not establish military or aviation employment. Gaming described as semi-professional has unresolved contractual/pay status.

2020 port report supplies contemporaneous ownership evidence and a concrete warning against title-based hours inference: both full-time and part-time managers existed. No individual assignment established. Do not convert generic enterprise-agreement coverage or port-wide economic FTE impacts to personal employment.

Searched first speech, public professional-profile index, primary2020 sustainability report and community minutes, parliamentary corporate-interest indexes, motorsport reports, banking/Hansen employer queries, festival entity and pre2010 history. Parliamentary artifact opens failed/robots while legitimate indexed declarations were available. No full-time personal interval, payroll termination or campaign-leave documentation found.

Port mixed-control classification retained; no new aggregate methodology created.2020 report confirms shareholder percentages, while precise control/voting rights and foreign-state ultimate-control evidence remain follow-up needs. Existing early festival/Knights/Prodigy facts sourced through secondary synthesis are preserved with their provenance, not upgraded to primary certainty.

Follow-up priorities: unnamed bank and Hansen business/employer;1990s–2002 and2007–2010 work; festival legal entity and nonprofit status; Knights control/form and dates; individual motorsport contracts and MotoGP employer; Inside Track term/pay; port hours, campaign leave and cessation. Current website survey options labelled Full-time concern respondents and are not personal evidence. Advance nationwide queue before repeating exhausted searches.

Second follow-up2026-10-02: maritime-festival Senate recollection corroborates previously recorded work; NRL/club2010 statement adds ownership context without resolving2005 legal payroll/entity form. No material enrichment counted because employment dates/hours/employer identity remain unchanged. Targeted bank/Hansen, Prodigy, festival entity and port resignation searches exhausted without new personal boundaries.

Current banking accounts are not employment evidence; bank-clerk title on derivative profile uncorroborated by own speech, so retained unspecified role. Staff part-time news concerns Barilaro, not Cadell. Knights2011/2014 transitions do not date his tenure. Next useful evidence: contemporary2005 Knights employment record/constitution, original festival agreement, bank/Hansen employer record or port payroll cessation/leave notice.

Further2October pass: targeted2005 Knights appointment/departure, Prodigy2007–08, and bank/Hansen queries. A contemporary fan-forum account calls him the new sales/marketing manager and describes a two-week tenure at an undated encounter; insufficient primary payroll/appointment detail to refine the existing June2005 start or legal employer. Public results otherwise repeat already-sourced titles and institutional histories. No new personal full-time or cessation evidence. Do not revisit generic full-time searches, which again return survey response options and unrelated workers; seek original2005 club staff/contract records or bank/Hansen documentation.

Third follow-up 2026-10-04: exact-name searches for the 2005 Newcastle Knights appointment, the Newcastle National Maritime Festival, Prodigy Motorsport and 2022 Port of Newcastle material returned only the derivative career chronology and already recorded contemporary article citations. No original employment notice, payroll entity, cessation, hours or leave record was located. No material enrichment counted; retain all gaps and advance pending original club, festival, bank/Hansen or port personnel evidence.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Targeted Greg Hansen payroll, early bank employer, Prodigy commercial-director, 2006/2009 motorsport and festival/council searches repeated existing chronology without original personnel or contracting boundaries. A different public LinkedIn profile identifies a Zurich claims consultant/OnePath in Greater Sydney; no identity bridge to the senator was found, so it was not substituted for his unidentified early bank. Direct profile access returned (429) Too Many Requests through the web tool; no same-route retry. A December2005 supporter-forum essay mentions Sales and Marketing manager but is an unverified competition entry, not a reliable employer appointment record; do not refine title/date from it. Need original Knights payroll/annual reports, festival employment entity, Hansen contract and early bank record; commercial titles and role overlap still do not prove full-time status.
